name: open-design
description_zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 等 coding agent 的本地优先设计应用：让 agent 成为设计引擎——原型、落地页、看板、幻灯片、图片与视频，导出为真实文件（HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4）。
description_en: Local-first design app for DeepSeek Harness and other coding agents: your agent becomes the design engine — prototypes, landing pages, dashboards, slides, images and video as real files (HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export).
install: 按仓库 QUICKSTART.md 安装（独立桌面应用 + DSH 集成，非 dsh plugin add bundle）

name: worldmonitor
description_zh: 实时全球情报看板：AI 驱动的新闻聚合、地缘政治监控与基础设施追踪，统一态势感知界面（支持 MCP 接入）。
description_en: Real-time global intelligence dashboard: AI-powered news aggregation, geopolitical monitoring and infrastructure tracking in a unified situational-awareness interface (supports MCP integration).
install: 按 README 部署（应用本体；支持 MCP 接入）

name: TrendRadar
description_zh: AI 舆情与热点监控：多平台热点聚合 + RSS 订阅 + 关键词筛选 + AI 筛选/翻译/分析简报直推手机；支持接入 MCP，赋能自然语言对话分析与情感洞察。
description_en: AI-driven public opinion and trend monitor with multi-platform hot-topic aggregation, RSS, smart alerts, AI news filtering/translation and analysis briefs; supports MCP integration for natural-language conversation and sentiment insight.
install: 按 README 部署（应用本体；支持 MCP 接入）

name: chrome-devtools-mcp
description_zh: 面向 coding agent 的 Chrome DevTools：官方 MCP 服务，让任意 MCP 客户端调试、检查并自动化 Chrome。
description_en: Chrome DevTools for coding agents: the official MCP server that lets any MCP client debug, inspect and automate Chrome.

name: codebase-memory-mcp
description_zh: 高性能代码智能 MCP 服务：把代码库索引为持久知识图谱（普通仓库毫秒级），支持 158 种语言、亚毫秒查询、节省 99% token，单静态二进制部署。
description_en: High-performance code intelligence MCP server: indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph (average repo in milliseconds), 158 languages, sub-ms queries, 99% fewer tokens, single static binary.
install: 从 Releases 下载对应平台二进制，按 README 配置 MCP 客户端

name: agency-agents-zh
description_zh: 267 个即插即用的 AI 专家角色，支持 Hermes Agent / Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot 等 18 种工具，覆盖工程/设计/营销/金融等 20 个部门；含 52 个中国市场原创智能体（小红书/抖音/微信/飞书/钉钉等）。
description_en: 267 plug-and-play AI expert roles for Hermes Agent / Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot and 18+ tools, covering engineering, design, marketing and finance departments, plus 52 China-market originals (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk).

name: ai-guide
description_zh: 程序员鱼皮的 AI 资源大全 + Vibe Coding 零基础教程：OpenClaw 保姆级教程、大模型玩法（DeepSeek/GPT/Gemini/Claude/GLM）、最新 AI 资讯、Prompt 提示词大全、AI 知识百科（Agent Skills/RAG/MCP/A2A）与 Harness Engineering 编程教程。
description_en: AI resource encyclopedia and zero-basics Vibe Coding tutorial: OpenClaw guides, model playbooks (DeepSeek/GPT/Gemini/Claude/GLM), AI news, prompt collections, AI knowledge base (Agent Skills/RAG/MCP/A2A) and Harness Engineering coding tutorials.

name: awesome-dsh-plugin
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件精选列表（都可用 `dsh plugin add` 安装）；dsh-market 插件市场与 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 的数据源。
description_en: Curated list of DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugins, installable via `dsh plugin add`; powers the dsh-market plugin market and awesome-dsh-plugin.com.

name: superpowers-zh
description_zh: AI 编程超能力 · 中文增强版：superpowers（116k+ ⭐）完整汉化 + 6 个中国原创 skills，让 Claude Code / Copilot CLI / Hermes Agent / Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro / Gemini CLI 等 16 款 AI 编程工具真正会干活。
description_en: AI coding superpowers, Chinese-enhanced edition: full localization of superpowers (116k+ stars) plus 6 original Chinese skills, for Claude Code / Copilot CLI / Hermes Agent / Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro / Gemini CLI and 16+ AI coding tools.

name: dsh-routing-suite
description_zh: DSH 路由套件：运行时注入器 + 任务感知推理模式路由预设（实测 P1-P23）。先装注入器，再装路由预设。
description_en: DSH routing suite: runtime injector + task-aware reasoning-mode router preset kit (measured P1-P23). Install the injector first, then the router preset.

name: dsh-web
description_zh: DSH Web 插件聚合生态：万物皆插件，经「创作工坊」分发。
description_en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web Plugin Aggregation Ecosystem: everything is a plugin, distributed via the Creative Workshop.

name: petdex
description_zh: 动画桌面宠物画廊：为 Codex、Claude Code、DeepSeek Harness、Hermes、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 等提供可安装的像素宠物。
description_en: A public gallery of animated pets for Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness, Hermes, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and more.
install: 在 petdex 画廊浏览并复制对应 harness 的安装命令（画廊站点本身非 dsh bundle）

name: modlens
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 首个视觉插件：给纯文本模型加视觉理解，返回 OCR/布局/语义的结构化 JSON。
description_en: First vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: bolts visual understanding onto text-only models, returning structured JSON evidence.

name: DSH-better-sidebar
description_zh: 开放的侧边栏基座：支持第三方扩展注册新侧边栏页；内置文件渲染/编辑、终端、侧边对话、Git 与子代理页面。
description_en: Open sidebar foundation: third-party extensions can register new sidebar pages. Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git and sub-agent pages.

name: WorkBuddyGuide
description_zh: WorkBuddy 实战开源蓝皮书：教程、真实工作流、Skills、MCP、自动化与多智能体实践。
description_en: A practical, open-source guide to mastering WorkBuddy through real-world workflows: tutorials, Skills, MCP, automation and multi-agent practice.

name: ecommerce-visual-copywriting-skill
description_zh: 电商视觉文案设计 SOP Skill：让电商设计小白一键做出资深水准的商品图片文案，兼容 Claude / Codex / Cursor / WorkBuddy 等 SKILL.md Agent。

name: WorkBuddy Skills Archive
description_zh: WorkBuddy 技能 / 连接器 / 专家归档，供离线学习与参考。
description_en: WorkBuddy skills / connectors / experts archive for offline study.

description_zh: 从 0 复刻 WorkBuddy 风格桌面 AI 助手 Harness：4 章 Python 教程，覆盖 Agent Loop、工具调用、记忆系统、Sidecar、沙箱设计，附 DeepSeek/OpenAI 评测轨迹。
description_en: Rebuild a WorkBuddy-style desktop AI assistant harness from zero: 4-chapter Python tutorial covering Agent Loop, tool calling, memory systems, sidecar, sandbox design, and DeepSeek/OpenAI evaluation traces.

description_en: Agent Skills for theming AI desktop apps: reference image -> reversible Codex/WorkBuddy skin -> verify, repair, publish.

name: tencentmeeting-cli
description_zh: 腾讯会议命令行工具（CLI），基于腾讯会议开放平台 OAuth2 授权，支持会议管理、录制管理、参会报告等；以 CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy Skill 形态分发。
description_en: Tencent Meeting command-line tool (CLI) built on the Tencent Meeting Open Platform OAuth2: meeting management, recording management and attendee reports; distributed as a CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy skill.

name: zhijian-ai-bluebook-workbuddy-harness
description_zh: 智见 AI 蓝皮书：拆解 WorkBuddy 的提示词、记忆、插件、专家、Skill 与安全边界。
description_en: Zhijian AI Bluebook: dissects WorkBuddy's prompts, memory, plugins, experts, Skills and security boundaries.

name: awesome-website-prompts-and-skills
description_zh: 腾讯 EdgeOne 官方资源合集：给 AI 编程工具一个 Prompt 或 Skill，即可生成精美酷炫的网页，或带登录、支付、AI 能力的完整网站（WorkBuddy × EdgeOne AI Prompts × Skills 挑战赛官方作品池）。
description_en: Official Tencent EdgeOne resource pool: give an AI coding tool one Prompt or Skill to generate polished websites, or complete sites with login, payment and AI capabilities. WorkBuddy x EdgeOne AI Prompts x Skills challenge works.

name: rayskills
description_zh: 面向 AI Builder 的实战 Skill 工具箱：10 个可执行、可验证、可恢复的工作流，/ray 路由 + 内容生产管线直达公众号与 X Articles 草稿箱；支持 Claude Code、Codex 与 WorkBuddy。
description_en: Practical Skill toolbox for AI Builders: 10 executable, verifiable, recoverable workflows, /ray routing plus a content-production pipeline straight into WeChat official account and X Articles drafts; works with Claude Code, Codex and WorkBuddy.

description_zh: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务：让任意支持 MCP 的 agent 读写仓库 / issue / PR。
